name: Aelis Varrow
found: The Crescent and Hoof, counting teamsters' coin by the fire pit.
appearance: 50s, broad, a teamster's whip coiled at her belt.
and_yet: Silver thread braided into her grey hair, like a waystone offering.
sayings: Pay up front. The road doesn't wait.
does_not_want: The party and the hunters brawling under her roof.
oddly_also: Keeps a tally of every rider who went north and didn't come back.
knows: Everything the caravans heard on the road.
